packages.name: Preferred: hold pressure 45 to 60 bar
packages.rationale: Part weight averaged 31.26 g, below the 32.00-32.30 g band. With the documented ~0.052 g/bar dependence of part weight on holding pressure, +15 bar implies about +0.78 g, which should bring the part into the band while keeping flash below its 0.4 % limit.

params.basis: Delta part weight +0.74 g required; 0.052 g/bar gives +15 bar.
params.exp_ref: S7 injection pilot: 0.05035 g/bar, write 60 to 63.7 bar reached band

packages.name: Cautious: hold pressure 45 to 56 bar
packages.rationale: Smaller correction that keeps a wider flash margin; expected to leave part weight slightly below the band and to require a second step.

params.basis: Half of the estimated correction, prioritising flash margin.
